mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shopion.tOrdOrderSmmryPrev201502 (ShipCmpletDate, ProdName, ShopProdCode, ShopName, ShopMdName, ChnlName, ChnlMdName, OrderCnt, ProdQty, SalePrice, SupplyPrice, BuyPrice, DeliFeeAmt, PromotFeeAmt, ProdMargin, NetMargin, ChnlMargin, ShopCode, ChnlCode, OrderState, ShopSvcCode, ChnlSvcCode) SELECT DATE(ShipCmpletDate) AS ShipCmpletDate, ProdName, ShopProdCode, ShopName, ShopMDName, ChnlName, ChnlMDName, COUNT(DISTINCT OrderNo) AS OrderCnt, SUM(ProdQty) AS ProdQty, SUM(SalePrice + NvPrice) AS SalePrice, SUM(SupplyPrice) AS SupplyPrice, SUM(BuyPrice) AS BuyPrice, SUM(DeliFeeAmt) AS DeliFeeAmt, SUM(PromotFeeAmt) AS PromotFeeAmt, SUM(ProdMargin) AS ProdMargin, SUM(NetMargin) AS NetMargin, SUM(ChnlMargin) AS ChnlMargin, ShopCode, ChnlCode, OrderState, 'SHP001' AS ShopSvcCode, 'SHP001' AS ChnlSvcCode FROM ( SELECT OP.ShipCmpletDate, S.ShopName, O.OrderNo, O.OrderState, OP.ProdCode, OP.ShopProdCode, OP.ProdName, S.MngrMd AS ShopMDName, OP.ProdQty, OP.SalePrice, OP.NvPrice, OP.SupplyPrice, OP.BuyPrice, OP.DeliFeeAmt, OP.PromotFeeAmt, OP.ProdMargin, OP.ChnlMargin, OP.NetMargin, S.ShopCode, Ch.ChnlCode, Ch.ChnlName, Ch.MngrMd AS ChnlMDName FROM shopion.tOrdOrderProd OP INNER JOIN shopion.tOrdOrder O ON OP.OrderNo = O.OrderNo INNER JOIN shopwizard.tCmpChnl Ch ON O.ChnlCode = Ch.ChnlCode INNER JOIN shopwizard.tCmpShop S ON OP.ShopCode = S.ShopCode WHERE OP.OrderState IN ('지불완료','출고지시','발주확인','배송시작','배송완료') AND OP.ShipCmpletDate >= DATE_FORMAT(#{startDate}, '%Y%m%d') AND OP.ShipCmpletDate < ADDDATE(DATE_FORMAT(#{endDate}, '%Y%m%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND Ch.SvcCode = 'SHP001' AND S.SvcCode = 'SHP001' ) T GROUP BY DATE(ShipCmpletDate), ShopCode, ShopName, ShopMDName, ProdCode, ShopProdCode, ProdName, ChnlCode, ChnlName, ChnlMDName
mapper.select: SELECT O.OrderNo FROM shopion.tOrdOrder O INNER JOIN shopion.tOrdOrderProd OP ON OP.OrderNo = O.OrderNo INNER JOIN shopwizard.tCmpChnl Ch ON O.ChnlCode = Ch.ChnlCode INNER JOIN shopwizard.tCmpShop S ON OP.ShopCode = S.ShopCode WHERE ( OP.ShipCmpletDate < ADDDATE(DATE_FORMAT(#{endDate}, '%Y%m%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) OR (OP.ShipCmpletDate IS NULL AND O.OrderReciptDate < ADDDATE(DATE_FORMAT(#{endDate}, '%Y%m%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY)) ) AND Ch.SvcCode = 'SHP001' AND S.SvcCode = 'SHP001'
